build_plan.exit_criteria: Both STL parts are non-empty, watertight, manifold, positive-volume, fit a 220 by 220 millimetre bed, and retain 0.7 millimetre radial plus 4 millimetre per-side axial pearl clearance.

components.duty: Carries hand load through broad walls and rolls through the modeled 65 degree endpoint change without hidden ballast or hardware.
components.form: One 92 by 42 by 30 millimetre C-shaped solid with two 12.7 millimetre radius open lip saddles and a broad rear press ridge.
components.interfaces: Two exposed 12.7 millimetre radius lip saddles receive the 12 millimetre radius pearl with 0.7 millimetre radial clearance.
components.name: Open-mouth clam shell
components.placement: Printed on either 92 by 42 millimetre broad side; used around the loose pearl with the mouth open.

components.duty: Acts as the visible rolling fulcrum and transfers freely between the two open shell saddles.
components.form: One 24 millimetre diameter by 22 millimetre long rounded cylindrical drum.
components.interfaces: The 22 millimetre axis length leaves 4 millimetres clearance at each side within the 30 millimetre shell width.
components.name: Loose pearl drum
components.placement: Printed on either 24 millimetre circular end and inserted through the unobstructed open mouth after cooling.

concept.interaction: Place the pearl drum in either open lip saddle, set the shell low, and press the broad rear ridge. The shell rolls and vaults 65 degrees over the loose pearl to a tall rest while the pearl transfers to the opposite open lip saddle. Turn the object around and repeat to reverse it.
concept.summary: A two-piece palm-sized open clam whose loose visible pearl drum becomes the rolling fulcrum for a reversible 65-degree vault.
concept.title: Pearlturn

research.geometry: The implementation uses a 92 by 42 by 30 millimetre shell envelope, a 24 by 22 millimetre pearl drum, 4 millimetres axial clearance per side, and 12.7 millimetre radius terminal saddles.
research.limits: CAD proves geometry, visibility, mesh integrity, and endpoint poses; it does not prove real friction, repeatability, tactile fit, or successful physical vaulting.
research.scope: The sealed Wish already compares the relevant mechanism families, so Make focused on exact geometry and deterministic CAD evidence.
